topics.label: Course Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation in the context of the course.

topics.label: Innate Recognition of Pathogens and Danger Signals
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor systems through which the innate immune system detects microbial products and cellular damage.

topics.label: Leukocyte Recruitment and Inflammatory Cascade Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte recruitment into tissues and coordinate systemic inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory responses are turned off, how damaged tissues are repaired, and how chronic inflammation persists.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-Up
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation and previews the subject of the next lecture.
